boundaries: Diagnostics are from the normal Lean file runner, not an inferred lexical use graph.
Source citation observations locate the parent import and child theorem definition; they do not add graph edges.
A failing baseline does not establish which declarations are unused or safe to delete.
settling_measurement: In a separately authorized source revision, add the missing child import, check that module within its existing proof budget, and rerun the same trust-audit command. The pinned-base failure remains a finding.
verdict: The unmodified pinned CI trust audit fails. This run cannot certify baseline root coverage.
